about_the_game:
Overview

TechWorld combines tower defence, action combat, and roguelike progression into a fast-paced strategic experience. Build your base of automated towers, fight alongside them in real-time battles, and adapt your tactics as enemy waves grow stronger. Every run offers new upgrades, challenges, and rewards.

Combat and Strategy

Build and upgrade automated defences, then fight alongside your towers in real-time combat. Collect gears, survive escalating waves of enemies, and unlock new maps, abilities, and upgrades as you progress through each challenge.

Upgrades and Progression

Each time you level up, you receive a selection of upgrade cards that offer unique stat boosts and abilities in roguelike fashion. Earn cash and gears from defeated enemies to improve your towers and equipment. At the end of each mission, gain Techpoints and crates containing valuable rewards. Once you have gathered enough Techpoints, convert them into Ascendpoints to unlock powerful permanent upgrades that redefine your robot’s potential.

Tech Tree, Inventory, and Map Selection

Expand your Tech Tree to unlock new upgrades, abilities, and tower enhancements that suit your preferred playstyle. Use your earned Techpoints and Ascendpoints to progress through different branches and create unique build paths for your robot.

Manage your inventory to open crates earned from mission completion, containing rare equipment and special abilities that boost your combat efficiency.

Customise your experience by adjusting map difficulty, enemy speed, and health for greater rewards. Higher settings offer increased challenge and better loot drops, perfect for players seeking tougher battles and faster progression. Advance through missions to unlock new maps and environments, each featuring stronger enemies and valuable resources.

Key Features

  • Action-packed tower defence combat where you fight alongside your towers in real time

  • Roguelike upgrade system with randomised upgrade cards and permanent progression

  • Custom difficulty settings for scaling rewards and challenge

  • Deep Tech Tree and inventory management for long-term strategy

  • Unlockable maps and modes that evolve as you advance

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD Phenom II X4 840
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 6850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: TechWorld is a fast-paced tower defence roguelike where you build, upgrade, and fight alongside your towers. Combine strategy and action as you battle waves of enemies, collect loot, and unlock new maps, abilities, and permanent upgrades to strengthen your robotic hero.
